_meta.purpose: Provenance audit of English-text sourcing for the 24 live Pratibha collections, for copyright/asteya reconciliation.

tiers.A: Clean — own fresh rendering or genuine public-domain translation. Keep + attribute.
tiers.B: PD-swappable — currently leans on a copyrighted translation, but a PD English alternative exists. Swap the anchor.
tiers.C: Copyright-derived — derived from an in-copyright translation, no PD English exists. Re-render from source or reduce to short attributed quote + own commentary.

_meta.primary_evidence: app/sources_registry.py (SOURCES list, sell_ready_tier field) cross-checked against data/raw_texts manuscript headers and data/raw_texts/pd/manifest.yml
